<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915244_theRebbe_950" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915244_theRebbe_950__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>True peace of the soul is achieved specifically through the revelation of the Yechidah, which nullifies opposing desires at their root.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it is explained there,</t>
    <t s="1">that the true essence of the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace" is specifically through the revelation of the Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="2">For the nullification of the desires of the Nefesh HaBahamis through the love that is above reason and intellect, which comes from the encompassing light of Chayah, is only because the will of the Nefesh HaElokis</t>
    <t s="3">(of the level of Chayah)</t>
    <t s="4">overpowers the will of the Nefesh HaBahamis.</t>
    <t s="5">[Rather, due to the force of the will of the Nefesh HaElokis, the desires of the Nefesh HaBahamis are automatically nullified.</t>
    <t s="6">For in the service that is according to reason and intellect, which is from the level of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah,</t>
    <t s="7">the refinement of the Nefesh HaBahamis is through the Nefesh HaElokis clothing itself in the Nefesh HaBahamis and doing battle with it,</t>
    <t s="8">but this is not the case with the level of Chayah,</t>
    <t s="9">where through the force of the will of the Nefesh HaElokis</t>
    <t s="10">(a will that is above reason),</t>
    <t s="11">they are nullified</t>
    <t s="12">(the desires of the Nefesh HaBahamis)</t>
    <t s="13">automatically.</t>
    <t s="14">But nevertheless, their nullification is only due to the overpowering of the Nefesh HaElokis,</t>
    <t s="15">and not that they are nullified in their very essence].</t>
    <t s="16">Therefore, this is not the true aspect of peace.</t>
    <t s="17">And the true essence of the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace" is through the revelation of the Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="18">For since the level of Yechidah has no opposite to counter it,</t>
    <t s="19">"the reflection of a reflection has no hold on it",</t>
    <t s="20">therefore,</t>
    <t s="21">the nullification of the desires of the Nefesh HaBahamis through the revelation of the Yechidah is</t>
    <t s="22">(not that through the revelation of the Yechidah a nullification of desires is brought about,</t>
    <t s="23">but rather)</t>
    <t s="24">that from the perspective of the Yechidah, there is no place from the outset for alien desires.</t>
    <t s="25">And this is "He redeemed my soul in peace... for many were with me",</t>
    <t s="26">that "for many were with me" is the reason</t>
    <t s="27">(because)</t>
    <t s="28">for "He redeemed my soul in peace",</t>
    <t s="29">for the service of "for many were with me" is the arousal and revelation of the Yechidah</t>
    <t s="30">(as explained at length in the maamar),</t>
    <t s="31">and through the revelation of the Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="32">the redemption of the Nefesh HaElokis is in a manner of peace,</t>
    <t s="33">"He redeemed my soul in peace."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even after the revelation of the Yechidah, the Nefesh HaElokis still requires redemption, but this redemption is achieved peacefully through contemplating the Yechidah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And it must be understood,</t>
    <t s="2">that since through the revelation of the Yechidah</t>
    <t s="3">(the service of "for many were with me")</t>
    <t s="4">there is no place for opponents,</t>
    <t s="5">then there is no need at that time for redemption,</t>
    <t s="6">and from the fact that "for many were with me" is the reason for "He redeemed my soul in peace"</t>
    <t s="7">[for a reason is the cause that precedes the effect that is brought about from it],</t>
    <t s="8">it implies,</t>
    <t s="9">that even after the matter of "for many were with me"</t>
    <t s="10">(the revelation of the Yechidah)</t>
    <t s="11">the Nefesh HaElokis still needs redemption</t>
    <t s="12">(except that the redemption is in peace).</t>
    <t s="13">And furthermore,</t>
    <t s="14">from the fact that "for many were with me" is the reason for "He redeemed my soul in peace from the battle against me",</t>
    <t s="15">it implies,</t>
    <t s="16">that in addition to the fact that even after the matter of "for many were with me" the Nefesh HaElokis</t>
    <t s="17">(my soul)</t>
    <t s="18">needs redemption</t>
    <t s="19">(in general),</t>
    <t s="20">it also needs redemption from the wars that are against it.</t>
    <t s="21">And at first glance,</t>
    <t s="22">even when the Nefesh HaBahamis is like one asleep</t>
    <t s="23">(who can later awaken again)</t>
    <t s="24">it does not actively wage war against the Nefesh HaElokis,</t>
    <t s="25">and certainly</t>
    <t s="26">when the desires of the Nefesh HaBahamis are nullified</t>
    <t s="27">(through the will of the Nefesh HaElokis of the level of Chayah),</t>
    <t s="28">how can it be that even after the revelation of the Yechidah</t>
    <t s="29">("for many were with me"),</t>
    <t s="30">when there is no place at all for the desires of the Nefesh HaBahamis,</t>
    <t s="31">the Nefesh HaElokis needs redemption from the wars that are against it?</t>
    <t s="32">And the explanation can be said,</t>
    <t s="33">that this that is said "for many were with me"</t>
    <t s="34">[from which it is implied</t>
    <t s="35">(as above)</t>
    <t s="36">that "He redeemed... from the battle against me" is after "for many were with me"]</t>
    <t s="37">is in order to hint,</t>
    <t s="38">that even one who is on a low level,</t>
    <t s="39">whose Nefesh HaElokis</t>
    <t s="40">(not only the level of Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="41">but the Nefesh HaElokis in general)</t>
    <t s="42">is in concealment within him,</t>
    <t s="43">to the extent that the Nefesh HaBahamis wages war against his Nefesh HaElokis,</t>
    <t s="44">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="45">through contemplating the matter of the Yechidah</t>
    <t s="46">[and the resolution that his conduct will be in accordance with the level of Yechidah within his soul],</t>
    <t s="47">"for many were with me",</t>
    <t s="48">the redemption of his Nefesh HaElokis from the wars of the Nefesh HaBahamis</t>
    <t s="49">("He redeemed my soul from the battle against me")</t>
    <t s="50">is in a manner of peace.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The peace in "redeemed in peace" refers to two types of peace, from above to below and from below to above, as hinted in the verse about Yaakov and the verse "and great peace have your children."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by prefacing what is said</t>
    <t s="2">(in our Torah portion)</t>
    <t s="3">"And I will return in peace to my father's house",</t>
    <t s="4">and the Baal HaGeulah explains,</t>
    <t s="5">that Yaakov's journey to Charan was in order to refine the sparks that were there,</t>
    <t s="6">and this is what he said "And I will return in peace to my father's house",</t>
    <t s="7">that the refinement of the sparks and their return</t>
    <t s="8">(their restoration)</t>
    <t s="9">to their source</t>
    <t s="10">("to my father's house")</t>
    <t s="11">would be in a manner of peace.</t>
    <t s="12">And the maamar adds,</t>
    <t s="13">that the meaning of "in peace" is two kinds of peace,</t>
    <t s="14">peace from above to below and peace from below to above.</t>
    <t s="15">And it can be said similarly regarding the word "in peace" in the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace",</t>
    <t s="16">that "in peace" is two kinds of peace,</t>
    <t s="17">from above to below and from below to above.</t>
    <t s="18">And this can be connected with the verse</t>
    <t s="19">"And all your children shall be taught of the L-rd, and great shall be the peace of your children",</t>
    <t s="20">that it can be said,</t>
    <t s="21">that the matter of the multiplicity of peace</t>
    <t s="22">("and great peace"),</t>
    <t s="23">multiplicity is not less than two,</t>
    <t s="24">is two levels of peace,</t>
    <t s="25">peace from above to below and peace from below to above.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
